name: SGT-003
summary: SGT-003 is Solid Biosciences' one-time IV AAV gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy: a microdystrophin carrying the nNOS-binding R16/17 repeats, delivered by Solid's own capsid POLARIS-101 (AAV-SLB101, AAV9-based), with steroid-only immunomodulation. Registrational path: Solid will meet the FDA late in Q4 2026 to discuss the INSPIRE DUCHENNE data package (NCT06138639, Phase 1/2, 53 dosed by 2026-08-04, microdystrophin expression) and seek guidance on accelerated approval, with IMPACT DUCHENNE (NCT07160634, Phase 3, randomised, placebo-controlled, n=80, ambulant 7 to <12, time-to-rise velocity at 18 months, primary completion 2029-01) as the confirmatory trial (10-Q 0001193125-26-337935). No BLA date is filed; Dyne's 10-Q reports Solid's intent to file in 2027, so 2028 is the first model year (judgement). Price anchor: Elevidys, the one approved DMD gene therapy, at its $3.2mm WAC less Sarepta's filed FY2025 21.25% gross-to-net, $2.52mm net per course. Pool: the book's DMD figures (11,952 prevalent, 367 a year) narrowed to ambulatory boys aged 4 and over (Elevidys's current label), AAV9-seronegative and outside the trials' excluded deletions: 13.2%. Uptake anchor: under its post-November 2025 ambulatory-only, boxed-warning label Elevidys treats about 159 patient-equivalents a year, 8.0% of its untreated eligible pool; SGT-003 is set at half that (judgement). Solid owns SGT-003 outright but owes two academic low-single-digit royalties (Washington, Missouri), read at 1% each.

therapy_mode.source: Solid 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-337935), MD&A: 'SGT-003 is administered as a one-time intravenous infusion'; same sentence in the FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-115928). INSPIRE DUCHENNE is 'a Phase 1/2 first-in-human, open-label, single-dose' trial at 1E14 vg/kg
therapy_mode.note: One infusion, not repeated: the 10-Q risk factors say patients 'create antibodies to the AAV capsid and a second administration of gene transfer might not be safe or successful'. Billed once, so each year's treated patients are that year's revenue, as the book models Elevidys-like one-time products (NTLA-2002 seed)

list_price_per_patient.source: Elevidys (delandistrogene moxeparvovec, Sarepta) wholesale acquisition cost $3.2mm per one-time treatment: BioPharma Dive, 'Sarepta prices Duchenne gene therapy at $3.2M' (biopharmadive.com/news/sarepta-duchenne-elevidys-price-million-gene-therapy/653720/); Fierce Pharma, 'After delays, Sarepta's DMD gene therapy Elevidys finally crosses FDA finish line at $3.2M' (fiercepharma.com/pharma/sareptas-dmd-gene-therapy-finally-makes-it-accelerated-approval-finish-line-restricted); '$3.2 million per infusion' in Gene Ther 2025 review, doi:10.1038/s41434-025-00561-6, PMID 40817386
list_price_per_patient.note: JUDGEMENT: parity with Elevidys. It is the only approved DMD gene therapy and SGT-003 would take the same place in care (one-time IV AAV microdystrophin for ambulatory boys). lookup.py demand returns no CMS rows for Elevidys or any DMD drug, so the anchor is the published WAC, not the CMS convention. Solid has not disclosed a price. Case for higher: Solid reports microdystrophin expression, cardiac signals and a steroid-only immunomodulation regimen, generally well tolerated in 53 participants (10-Q); Hemgenix lists at $3.5mm (same Fierce and BioPharma Dive coverage). Case for lower: a second or third entrant (REGENXBIO's RGX-202 also plans a 2027 filing, Dyne 10-Q 0001193125-26-323639) facing payers who have seen Elevidys's safety record; US most-favoured-nation pricing pressure cited in Solid's 10-K

gross_to_net_pct.source: Sarepta FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-084144), Note 7 reserves for discounts and allowances: 2025 provision $503,131k (chargebacks 192,037, rebates 184,854, prompt pay 19,376, other 106,864) against net product revenue $1,864,296k, of which Elevidys $898,731k (48.2%). 503,131 / (1,864,296 + 503,131) = 0.2125
gross_to_net_pct.note: The anchor is a published WAC, so neither Medicare convention applies and the discount is the comparator's own filed one, the figure the verified deramiocel seed carries. Direction checked: 0.2125 comes off list, net $2.52mm per course. FY2025 is used because Elevidys was nearly half of Sarepta's product revenue and chargebacks, which include PHS 340B sales to hospitals where gene therapies are infused, rose from $130,180k in 2024 to $192,037k. Cross-check that the net price is about right: revenue-parity patient-equivalents at $2.52mm through Q1 2025 are 554 commercial patients, which with trial patients fits Sarepta's 'more than 900 individuals treated to-date' (safety update, 2025-06-15, investorrelations.sarepta.com). Case for lower: solving FY2023 and FY2024 (Elevidys 17.5% and 45.9% of net revenue; provisions 258,646 and 399,396) for two constant rates gives Elevidys 0.179 and PMOs 0.185, so a gene-therapy-only discount may be nearer 18%. Case for higher: outcomes-based contracts and a later entrant's rebates

discontinuation_pct.unit: share of the treated stock stopping per year
discontinuation_pct.source: one course: the engine's one_time mode bills the year's new patients and does not carry a treated stock (backend/forecast.py)
discontinuation_pct.note: Set so no treated stock is carried in either mode. Re-dosing is not modelled: anti-capsid antibodies after dosing preclude it (Solid 10-Q risk factors)

cogs_per_patient.source: none filed. Solid's FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-115928) and 2026 10-Qs (0001193125-26-219337, 0001193125-26-337935) give SGT-003 R&D spend ($47,458k in H1 2026, 'primarily related to manufacturing and clinical costs') but no per-course cost of goods
cogs_per_patient.note: Left null. Process performance qualification batches are due in 2026 (10-Q), so no commercial cost exists yet. WARNING for the company step: lookup.py seed returns no Solid rows, and the engine charges cogs_pct x revenue in one_time mode when this field is null, so unless the company step supplies a cost of sales the build charges none

forecast_start_year.source: Solid 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-337935): 'We plan to meet with the FDA late in the fourth quarter of 2026 to discuss the INSPIRE DUCHENNE SGT-003 data package and to seek guidance on a potential accelerated approval pathway for SGT-003'. Solid 2026 outlook release (investors.solidbio.com, 'Solid Biosciences Provides 2026 Outlook'): 'Together, INSPIRE DUCHENNE and IMPACT DUCHENNE are intended to support a potential accelerated approval in the U.S.' Dyne 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-323639): Solid (SGT-003) and REGENXBIO (RGX-202) 'have both recently reported positive data ... as well as an intent to file for approval with the FDA in 2027'. IMPACT DUCHENNE primary completion 2029-01 (NCT07160634, book trials table)
forecast_start_year.note: JUDGEMENT. Registrational path: accelerated approval on microdystrophin expression from INSPIRE DUCHENNE, with IMPACT DUCHENNE (FDA-aligned in a February 2026 Type C meeting: ambulant 7 to <12, TTR velocity at 18 months) as the confirmatory trial; first participant dosed April 2026. A BLA filed in 2027 after the late-Q4 2026 meeting, with Fast Track and Rare Pediatric Disease designations, gives an action date in late 2027 or 2028, so 2028 is the first model year; the ramp starts at 8.5% of peak in year 0, which absorbs a part year. Case for later: the FDA meeting has already slipped from the first half of 2026 (FY2025 10-K) to late Q4 2026, and Solid has not stated a BLA date. If the FDA wants IMPACT data, the 18-month endpoint reads out after 2029-01 and launch moves to about 2030 to 2031. Solid's own risk factors cite 'increased scrutiny of accelerated approval pathways'. Case for earlier: none; no BLA can be filed before the FDA meeting

exus_multiple.source: Solid 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-337935): EC orphan designation, a positive PDCO opinion on the Paediatric Investigation Plan and a UK ILAP Innovation Passport, but no ex-US marketing filing and no ex-US partner. The closest comparator was refused in the EU: book eu_medicines, Elevidys EMEA/H/C/005293, status Refused (Roche Registration GmbH)
exus_multiple.note: Null, so the engine models the US only. The accelerated-approval path is US-specific, and Elevidys's EU refusal shows expression data do not carry an EU approval. Elevidys's ex-US sales are Roche's and absent from Sarepta's product revenue (FY2025 10-K Note 7 reports Elevidys in the US only); its Japan approval is conditional, ages 3 to <8 (Sarepta 8-K 0001193125-26-071566). Case for a value later: IMPACT DUCHENNE runs in Australia, Canada, the EU and the UK, so a traditional ex-US filing could follow its readout. The book's fallback for an ex-US DMD split is Sarepta's PMOs, 165,183 / 800,382 = 0.2064 in FY2025 (verified DYNE-251 seed)

economics_share.unit: share of the asset after royalties paid, netted over the engine's current margin of 1.0
economics_share.source: Solid FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-115928), Note 12 License Agreements. University of Washington (2015 exclusive licence to 'novel micro-dystrophins' for Duchenne): 'The Company must also pay royalties of a low single digit percentage of future sales by the Company and its sublicensees'. University of Missouri (2015 exclusive licence to 'a novel synthetic microdystrophin gene' for Duchenne): 'The Company must pay a royalty of a low single digit percentage of future sales'. SGT-003 carries the SGT-001 microdystrophin family with the R16/17 repeats (Gene Ther 2025 review, PMID 40817386)
economics_share.note: Solid owns SGT-003 and has no commercial partner. Two royalties, each 'low single digit', read at the bottom as the book reads 'low single digits' (1%, the Adimanebart IV and verified NTLA-2002 seeds): 2% of sales. House netting (margin - royalty) / margin. Solid has no company cost rows (lookup.py seed returns none), so the engine's margin is currently 1.0 and the value is 0.98; the company step must re-strike it as (m - 0.02) / m once Solid's cost block exists. JUDGEMENT that both licences reach SGT-003: the filing ties them to the Duchenne microdystrophin programme, not to SGT-003 by name. Ultragenyx: the FY2025 10-K files no payable to Ultragenyx. Its only traces are the October 2020 sale of 521,719 shares and a $0.4mm payment to the University of Washington on signing the Ultragenyx collaboration, a sublicence out of Solid's microdystrophin; the 10-K lists only the Stock Purchase and Investor Agreements as exhibits. Not in this field: remaining academic milestones of about $3.4mm (Washington) and $1.9mm (Missouri), and minimum annual royalties. Case for lower: the Harvard (2016, 2017), Michigan (2016) and Life Technologies cell-line (2016) licences are filed as exhibits 10.44 to 10.47 without terms, and the 10-K says such agreements may carry 'royalties, milestone payments and sublicensing fees' ($18.3mm of potential milestones in total); no royalty on SGT-003 is stated under them, so this is not a refusal ground. The issued licensed US patents expire 2028 to 2036, so the academic royalties may lapse early in the forecast

prevalence.source: carried by the book: the verified deramiocel (CAPR) and DYNE-251 seeds' figure, /tmp/claude-0/price/verified/CAPR_deramiocel_cap_1002.json and DYN_zeleciment_rostudirsen_dyne_251.json: Crisafulli S et al., Orphanet J Rare Dis 2020;15:141 (PMID 32503598), 7.1 per 100,000 males x 168.34mm US males (Census Vintage 2024)
prevalence.note: Carried by the book, written out so one disease keeps one number whatever the load order. lookup.py pool Duchenne returns nothing yet; the figure lives in the two verified DMD seeds. Solid's own range is 5,000 to 15,000 US cases (8-K 0001193125-25-262795)

incidence.source: carried by the book: the verified deramiocel and DYNE-251 seeds' figure: Crisafulli 2020 birth prevalence 19.8 per 100,000 live male births x 1,854,394 US male births in 2024 (NVSR Births: Final Data for 2024)
incidence.note: Carried by the book. The engine filters it by eligible_pct: 367 x 0.1323 = 48.6 a year. That understates the real inflow to an ambulatory 4-and-over pool, which every surviving boy enters at age 4 (about 196 a year after the antibody and mutation filters); see untreated_carryover_pct

eligible_pct.source: Three filters. (1) Ambulatory, aged 4 and over: 0.2478. Median age at loss of ambulation 13 years on corticosteroids and 10 years without (Koeks Z et al., J Neuromuscul Dis 2017;4:293, doi:10.3233/JND-170280, PMID 29125504, TREAT-NMD, 5,345 patients), weighted by US steroid initiation of 68.9% (MD STARnet, Thomas S et al., J Child Neurol 2025, PMID 40879420, as the verified deramiocel seed cites): 0.689 x (13 - 4) + 0.311 x (10 - 4) = 8.07 ambulatory years from age 4, x 367.17 a year = 2,962 boys, / 11,952 = 0.2478. (2) Seronegative to the capsid: 0.64. AAV-SLB101 is AAV9 with a 7-amino-acid insertion (trade coverage found by search, CGTlive, cgtlive.com/view/solid-next-generation-dmd-gene-therapy-cleared-first-in-human-trial); AAV9 neutralising antibodies in 36% of 101 US males with DMD (Verma S et al., Hum Gene Ther 2023;34:430, doi:10.1089/hum.2022.081, PMID 36324212). Both trials require participants 'negative for AAV antibodies'. (3) Not carrying an excluded deletion: at most 0.834. IMPACT DUCHENNE excludes 'any deletion variant or variant predicted not to express exons 1 to 11, exons 42 to 45, or exons 57 to 69' (NCT07160634 listing, clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07160634); INSPIRE excludes deletions in exons 1-11 or 42-45 (CGTlive). In the TREAT-NMD global database (Bladen CL et al., Hum Mutat 2015;36, doi:10.1002/humu.22758, PMID 25604253, 7,149 mutations, Table 2), deletions amenable to skipping exon 43 (7.5% of mutations), exon 44 (7.1%) and exon 8 (2.0%) each lie wholly in an excluded region, since a deletion adjacent to exon 43 includes exon 42 or 44, one adjacent to exon 44 includes 43 or 45, and one adjacent to exon 8 includes 7 or 9: 1 - 0.166 = 0.834. Product 0.2478 x 0.64 x 0.834 = 0.1323
eligible_pct.note: JUDGEMENT on the label: ambulatory, 4 and over, the population of Elevidys's current label (ambulatory patients 4 years and older after the non-ambulatory population was removed in November 2025, Sarepta 10-Q 0001193125-26-335003), the FDA's standing view of where an AAV microdystrophin's benefit-risk holds. The trials are narrower: INSPIRE enrolled ambulatory boys 4 to 11 weighing 50 kg or less (10 m walk/run under 30 s), IMPACT ambulant 7 to <12; a label capped at 11 would remove the ambulatory boys aged 12 and over and lower this value. Filter (1) treats the median age at loss of ambulation as the mean and counts every boy aged 4 as diagnosed. Filter (2) is a JUDGEMENT to use the parent capsid; Verma found higher seroprevalence in ambulatory than non-ambulatory boys, and Solid's assay and threshold are not public, so 0.64 may overstate. The rh74 comparison is 86.1% seronegative by total binding antibody below 1:400 (Goedeker NL et al., Ther Adv Neurol Disord 2023, PMID 36710722). Filter (3) is a ceiling: deletions starting at exon 45 that are amenable to skipping exons 51, 53 or 55 (for example 45-50, 45-52, 45-54), deletions in exons 57 to 69 and proximal deletions not adjacent to exon 8 are also excluded but not counted, so the true share is lower, if the label carries the trial's exclusions at all (Elevidys's label kept only an exon 8 and/or 9 contraindication from its trials' wider exclusions). Weight, liver function and prior gene therapy are not applied. Pool: 11,952 x 0.1323 = 1,581 US boys

untreated_carryover_pct.unit: share of untreated eligible patients still eligible the next year
untreated_carryover_pct.source: house convention (BRIEF.md; remternetug and direclidine seeds): retention = pool / (pool + inflow) = 1,581.2 / (1,581.2 + 48.55) = 0.9702
untreated_carryover_pct.note: JUDGEMENT. Untreated ambulatory boys leave the eligible pool when they lose ambulation, about one-eighth a year (1 / 8.07 ambulatory years), and every boy turning 4 enters it, about 196 a year after the antibody and mutation filters. The engine sees only 48.6 a year of inflow (incidence times eligible_pct), so the stationary retention is used rather than the Zolgensma default of 1.0. A turnover model with the real inflow and exit gives 444 patients over the first ten years on this peak and ramp; this setting gives 420 and 1.0 gives 488, so both engine settings sit within 10%

penetration_peak_pct.unit: share of the untreated eligible pool treated per year at peak
penetration_peak_pct.source: Elevidys, the incumbent AAV microdystrophin, under its current ambulatory-only boxed-warning label. Net revenue $102.0mm Q1 2026 (Sarepta 8-K 0001193125-26-208966) and $98.1mm Q2 2026, $200,090k for H1 (10-Q 0001193125-26-335003): x 2 / $2.52mm net = 158.8 patient-equivalents a year. Its eligible pool: 11,952 x 0.2478 (ambulatory 4+) x 0.861 (AAVrh74-seronegative, Goedeker, PMID 36710722) = 2,550. Already treated: 2023-2025 net revenue $200,356k + $820,791k + $898,731k (FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-084144) / $2.52mm = 762 patient-equivalents, 83% ambulatory (Sarepta: of more than 900 treated, about 150 non-ambulatory, 2025-06-15 safety update and call, via search) = 635. Untreated 2,550 - 635 = 1,915, plus 78 of engine inflow: 158.8 / 1,994 = 0.0797 a year. SGT-003 at 0.5x: 0.0398
penetration_peak_pct.note: JUDGEMENT: 0.5x Elevidys's current capture. Two parts: (1) by 2028 Elevidys will have treated about 953 ambulatory boys, 37% of the shared pool at its current rate, and a boy treated with one AAV gene therapy is excluded from the other (INSPIRE excludes prior gene transfer), while the engine starts SGT-003's pool untreated, so about 0.63 carries that depletion, which fades as treated cohorts age out; (2) about 0.8 for sharing the flow with Elevidys and, from 2027-28, RGX-202. How the 2025 safety events bear on this: safety events announced in March and June 2025 (fatal acute liver failure in non-ambulatory patients, per the label's boxed warning in Sarepta's 8-K 0001193125-26-010116) led to a halt of non-ambulatory shipments, an FDA-requested US pause from 22 July 2025, resumption for ambulatory patients on 31 July, and in November 2025 a boxed warning for acute liver injury and failure with non-ambulatory patients removed from the indication (Sarepta 10-Q 0001193125-26-335003). Quarterly Elevidys revenue fell from $375.0mm in Q1 2025 to $98.1mm in Q2 2026, and Sarepta attributes the fall to 'changes in demand following the safety events ... and subsequent label update'. The anchor therefore reflects both the narrower label and depressed demand. Case for higher: the Q1 2025 rate, 595 patient-equivalents a year, was 3.7 times today's, so latent demand exists that a better-tolerated product (steroid-only regimen; Solid reports two treatment-related serious adverse events in 53 dosed, 10-Q 0001193125-26-337935) could recover. Case for lower: Elevidys has three-year EMBARK data and incumbency, Sarepta is testing sirolimus to reopen non-ambulatory dosing, a third gene therapy is due, and Solid launches with no commercial infrastructure. Engine check (pool 1,581, inflow 48.6, retention 0.9702, curve below): 5.5 patients in 2028, 28.6 in 2030, peak 56.7 in 2033 ($143mm US at $2.52mm net), 51.8 in 2037

ramp_steepness.source: book: Enhertu's CMS Part B launch fit (864, 1,904, 4,841, 7,105, 8,410 beneficiaries 2020-2024; lookup.py demand Enhertu), k = 1.08, midpoint 2.2, as carried by the MK-1045 seed and used by the book's one-time seeds (NTLA-2002, AZD0120, BMS-986353)
ramp_steepness.note: JUDGEMENT to reuse the book's one-time convention. The book has no DMD or gene therapy launch series (no Elevidys rows in drug_demand), and Elevidys's own curve is broken by label changes in 2023, 2024 and 2025, so it cannot be fitted. Case for faster: after its June 2024 label expansion Elevidys went from $820.8mm for all of 2024 to $375.0mm in Q1 2025 alone, a near-step launch into a waiting pool. Case for slower: Solid has no commercial organisation, CDMO supply and treatment-site onboarding for a one-time infusion

ramp_midpoint_year.source: as ramp_steepness (Enhertu fit carried in the book)
ramp_midpoint_year.note: Unshifted. Year 0 (2028) runs at 8.5% of peak, which also absorbs a part-year launch. The penetration anchor is a steady capture rate, not solved through this curve, so moving the curve moves timing, not the peak
